Subject: Staged exit guardrail proposal — Aurelia Systems (RDW-4721)

Team,

Quick escalation — Aurelia (Sarah Gupta) has pushed back on the standard ramp/termination language. Deal summary: 12-month term, $198k ARR, committed throughput starts month 1 at 30% of committed QPS, ramp to 100% by month 3. Customer is asking for an early opt-out after 60 days with the ability to downsize to 50% of committed capacity with no penalty and a pro-rated credit for unused committed tokens. They also asked for a one-time 10% implementation discount if we accept the opt-out.

Why this matters: if we accept unrestricted 60-day opt-out + 50% floor without controls, we risk material churn and revenue recognition volatility. I asked for the SOW and redlines (attached). Requesting:
- Exec approval for a negotiated opt-out path (proposed language below).
- An exception to our standard discount policy (10% one-time) or counter-offer guidance.
- Legal review of the opt-out wording to avoid a “free exit” scenario.

Proposed compromise (draft language):
- Staged ramp: 30% month 1, 60% month 2, 100% month 3.
- Early opt-out allowed after day 60 with a 30-day notice; if exercised, customer may reduce committed capacity to no less than 50% of original commit.
- If opt-out exercised, Redwood will issue a one-time pro-rated credit covering the remainder of the month in which opt-out was exercised.
- Any pricing concession limited to a one-time term discount; marketing/promotional credits separate.

Attachments: SOW v3 + Aurelia redline.

Action requested: rishi (finance) and laura (sales ops) — please weigh in on floor/credit economics. Vivek/karthik — need final OK on any discount exception and a legal sign-off path. I’ll aim to get customer sign-off on the revised language if we get the green light today.

Thanks,
Camila
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Camila — thanks for the write-up. High level thoughts from finance:
- We should avoid giving a clean 50% floor with immediate effect. Suggest a minimum revenue floor of 40% for the remainder of the contract if opt-out is exercised before month 6. That preserves some committed revenue.
- Alternate ramp structure that reduces early risk: 30% (M1), 60% (M2), 85% (M3), 100% (M4). That softens the cliff and gives time for adoption signals.
- If opt-out occurs, apply a 30-day notice plus a one-month pro-rated credit (as you proposed). Do not offer prepaid refunds or multi-month credits.
- Discount: a one-time commercial discount >5% requires VP approval; anything <=5% can be approved by Sales Ops with finance sign-off.

If legal confirms opt-out language that enforces notice + floor + no retroactive refunds, I can sign off on the credit structure. Marking this as high priority for revenue recognition.

-rishi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Staged exit guardrail proposal — Aurelia Systems (RDW-4721)

Team — I’ll approve a bounded exception to close this deal. Conditions:
1) Discount: approve a one-time 7% term discount (conditional) — this is the maximum for this tier and requires written acknowledgement from the customer that the discount is contingent on the ramp/floor and meeting adoption milestones (monthly usage reviews for first 90 days).
2) Floor & notice: accept a 50% minimum floor with a 30-day notice if the opt-out is exercised, but only if legal inserts an explicit non-retroactivity clause (no refunds for prior months) and a reporting clause (customer will provide adoption metrics on day 30 & day 60).
3) Ramp cadence: accept Rishi’s modified ramp but permit an accelerated path (30% / 60% / 85% / 100%) as an option in the SOW.
4) SLA & data: require standard SLA and existing data retention terms; no changes to audit logging.

Camila — you have conditional exec approval to offer the 7% discount and the staged opt-out language above. Get legal to redline the exact wording and loop in Aurelia legal for final sign-off. If Aurelia presses for a larger discount, escalate back to me.

—Vivek
SVP, Sales
Redwood Inference

Following up with the final language — legal (Karthik) provided the redline and I’ve attached the updated contract. Key points in the redline (extract):

> "Customer may request a reduction in committed capacity after the 60th day of the initial term provided a 30-day written notice is delivered. Any reduction may not decrease committed capacity below fifty percent (50%) of the originally contracted throughput for the remaining term. No retroactive refunds or credits will be issued for periods prior to the effective date of the reduction. Redwood will issue a one-time pro-rated credit covering the remainder of the month in which the reduction becomes effective. Customer agrees to provide adoption metrics on day 30 and day 60 following contract execution to validate ramp progression. Any pricing concession (the one-time 7% term discount) is contingent upon adherence to these terms and is non-transferable."

I’ve sent the redline and the updated SOW to Aurelia legal (cc’d). Next steps:
- Aurelia to confirm acceptance of the redline (Sarah/Tom).
- If they accept, we finalize DocuSign and apply the 7% term discount in the invoice.
- Rishi/Finance: please confirm revenue recognition path for the 7% discount and the floor so we tag the deal correctly (deal id RDW-4721).
- Laura/Sales Ops: please prepare the adoption review cadence (30/60/90 days) and calendar invites to start once signed.

Thanks everyone — I’ll keep this thread updated with Aurelia’s reply.

Camila
